node.html: Java implementation of Huffman coding that builds an optimal prefix-code tree with a priority queue, encodes and decodes text, and verifies round-trip correctness. Reduced a 2.35M-bit Project Gutenberg book to 1.44M bits, a 38.75% saving over fixed 7-bit encoding.

Spring Boot web app for searching flights, registering and logging in users, and booking reservations, secured with Spring Security role-based access. Generates a PDF itinerary with iText and emails it to the passenger, and exposes REST endpoints for check-in updates.

REST backend for residential-community visitor tracking with Admin, Gatekeeper, and Resident roles. Uses Spring Security with Redis-backed sessions, paginated visit history, request validation with centralized error handling, a scheduled job that expires stale visits, and Swagger/OpenAPI docs.

Angular frontend and Spring Boot (Spring Data JPA) backend, containerized with Docker and deployed on Amazon EC2 with Jenkins CI/CD and Rancher orchestration. Uses Amazon RDS (multi-AZ) and S3 static hosting, reaching 99.99% uptime with 200+ concurrent users.

Spring Boot microservices with REST APIs for survey CRUD that respond in under 200ms, backed by Amazon RDS (MySQL). Runs on Kubernetes with a Jenkins CI/CD pipeline, cutting deployment time by 50% and increasing release frequency by 40%.
Architected and constructed a storage system utilizing Java, JSP, and MySQL, to securely store files using data encryption mechanisms to generate tags and ciphertext in cloud storage.
